summary: Configure a 50 Hz timer PWM output and create an SG90-style microsecond/angle control module.
requires: A validated board profile with the PWM pin, board silkscreen, 3.3 V signal level, external 5 V servo supply, common ground, and shared-network conflicts.
A verified timer clock contract that produces 50 Hz PWM on the selected channel.
A planned external-supply acknowledgement for the servo connection.
verifications: Verify the generated .ioc selects the planned timer channel, PWM pin, and 50 Hz counter settings.
Verify the APB timer clock rule and advanced-timer main output requirement when TIM1 or TIM8 is used.
Compile the generated module and record the external 5 V/common-ground connection checklist.
